screening_decisions.reason: Double-blind randomized trial of aminophylline vs placebo in acute ischemic stroke; treatment administered during the acute hospitalization period (consistent with within 1 week). Meets randomized, control, acute AIS criteria.
Double-blind randomized trial of intravenous aminophylline vs placebo in patients with acute cerebral infarction. Meets randomized, control, acute AIS criteria; timing consistent with acute phase.
Open-label, single-arm dose-escalation study (no randomization, no placebo/control). Fails the 'randomized trials compared with placebo or control' criterion.

Physiologic study on cerebral metabolism with vincamine/aminophylline across mixed subjects; not clearly acute ischemic stroke population and no clear randomized AIS RCT. Fails population/design criteria.

Randomized, double-blind, cross-over caffeine vs placebo in patients recovering from an acute ischemic stroke. Population is AIS; comparator is placebo. Timing relative to onset not explicit (may be beyond 1 week), but unclear in abstract—include conservatively for full-text check.

Randomized, double-blind, cross-over caffeine vs placebo in stroke patients recovering from an acute ischemic stroke. Comparator present; AIS population. Timing vs onset not explicit—include conservatively pending full-text verification.
Intracarotid aminophylline physiologic study; not a randomized trial vs placebo/control in confirmed/presumed acute ischemic stroke patients.
Animal study in cats; not a randomized controlled clinical trial in people with acute ischemic stroke.
Animal study in dogs; not a randomized controlled clinical trial in people with acute ischemic stroke.
Mechanistic/overview report; lacks evidence of a randomized trial vs placebo/control in acute ischemic stroke patients.
